sections.title: Four Non-Negotiable Pillars of the ADJ Standard

blocks.v: In an educational landscape clouded by transactional promises and quick fixes, our pedagogy rests upon four uncompromising institutional principles designed to produce permanent academic resilience.
Strict Group-Only Learning

We strictly reject isolated 1-on-1 home drills. Candidates advance through rigorous, synchronized syllabus milestones in cohesive cohorts, unlocking mutual peer accountability and healthy intellectual friction.
Coaching Until Matriculation
Our contractual responsibility does not end when JAMB or WAEC results are released. We counsel students through Post-UTME, JAMB CAPS transfers, subject combination blending, and formal clearance.
Honest Scope & Zero Gimmicks
No "miracle centers", no illegal leaked materials, and zero false assurances. We teach pure syllabus mastery, time-management techniques, and genuine cognitive preparedness that withstands scrutiny.
Free First Diagnostic
A risk-free evaluation milestone. Prospective candidates and parents receive an empirical breakdown of subject deficits before payment or formal enrollment, ensuring total alignment and transparency.

How do I get here from Ikorodu Garage / Benson?

From Ikorodu Garage, board a bus or tricycle heading toward Igbogbo / Igbe Road . Alight at Laara Bus Stop . From Laara Bus Stop, enter Banana Estate street opposite the Community Central Mosque; ADJ consultants is hosted within the Greater Heights complex 150 meters inwards.
What should students bring to the Diagnostic Session?

Please bring previous term results, mock reports, or prior JAMB/WAEC slips if available. Candidates should also bring writing materials for the brief 30-minute subject assessment. Calculators are provided inside our CBT Practice Lab.
Can distant or working candidates consult online?

Yes. If you reside outside Ikorodu (or work during daytime hours for IELTS/Direct Entry), select the 'Live Online' radio option above. We will send a secured Google Meet or Zoom appointment link accompanied by our digital diagnostic portal credentials.
